title: Payments & ticketing
subtitle: Get your account ready to sell tickets online on events.taghunter.fr. Sales money goes straight to your own Stripe account.
loadError: Could not load your payment settings.
unavailable: Ticketing is not enabled on your account yet. Contact Tag Hunter to enable it.

commission.title: Booking fee
commission.text: Your customers pay a booking fee on top of the ticket price: {{rate}} + {{fixed}} per paid ticket. It goes to Tag Hunter automatically; you receive your full ticket price, minus Stripe's card fees.

legal.title: Legal information
legal.help: Shown on your event pages, on the receipts sent to your customers and on Tag Hunter commission invoices.
legal.vat_exempt: Not VAT registered (VAT not applicable, art. 293 B CGI)
legal.vat_default: Default VAT rate on your tickets
legal.vat_default_help: Can be changed later per ticket type or add-on.
legal.vat_valid: Checked with the EU VIES service
legal.vat_invalid: Number rejected by the EU VIES service
legal.country_help: Your company's country. It can't be changed once the Stripe account exists.
legal.legal_email_help: Shown on your pages; buyers' replies to our emails go to this address.

terms.title: Platform terms
terms.text: To sell on events.taghunter.fr you accept the platform terms, including the data processing agreement (you are the data controller, Tag Hunter is the processor).
terms.newVersion: A new version of the terms is available: please accept it.

stripe.title: Stripe account
stripe.help: Stripe collects your customers' payments and pays them out to your bank account. You keep your own Stripe dashboard (sales, payouts, refunds).
stripe.notConfigured: Online payment is being set up by Tag Hunter. You'll be able to connect your Stripe account very soon.
stripe.needLegal: First complete your legal information and accept the platform terms.
stripe.connectHelp: You'll be sent to Stripe to create an account or sign in to an existing one (ID document, bank details).

stateHelp.onboarding_incomplete: Your Stripe account exists, but sign-up isn't finished.
stateHelp.pending_verification: Stripe is checking your details. This usually takes a few minutes, sometimes a few days.
stateHelp.action_needed: Stripe needs more information. Without it, payments or payouts may be paused.
stateHelp.disconnected: Your Stripe account was disconnected from Tag Hunter. Paid sales are paused.

stripe.error: Stripe could not process the request: {{message}}

errors.required_when_subject: Required when you are VAT registered.
errors.vat_country_mismatch: The VAT number doesn't match the selected country.
errors.vat_siret_mismatch: The VAT number doesn't match the SIRET.
errors.unsupported_country: This country isn't supported yet (euro only).
errors.country_locked: The country can't be changed: your Stripe account already exists.

invoices.title: Commission invoices
invoices.help: Every month Tag Hunter issues an invoice for the booking fees taken on your sales of the previous month (or a credit note if they were refunded). Nothing to pay: the fees are already taken automatically.
